6584c7fa5f53f6fea9b65cfde0f82867b0bd742d.summary: News article on the April 2021 sentencing of Ukrainian national Fedir Hladyr to 10 years in prison by a US federal court. Hladyr was alleged to be an administrator of the FIN7 cybercrime group. Prosecutors say FIN7 stole payment card data from restaurant and hospitality chains and hacked financial firms, and they estimate losses of $3 billion to $5.7 billion, against an earlier researcher estimate of $1 billion. Hladyr was arrested in Germany in January 2018 and pleaded guilty in September 2019. In early 2020 the group reportedly mailed malware-laced USB sticks to multiple organisations.
